timeline.author: ievgen.degtiarenko

timeline.body:
Cancel shard allocation command is broken for initial desired balance versions and might allocate shard on the node where it is not supposed to be. This if fixed by https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/93635. Disabling test when upgrading from affected versions.

Closes: #93271

Maybe it's just me but I struggle to parse this, could we say this instead?

```suggestion
        assumeTrue("Desired nodes was introduced in 8.1", UPGRADE_FROM_VERSION.onOrAfter(Version.V_8_1_0));
```
I wonder if we should consider an issue if we report a node desired even if `can_remain_decision=no`.

reply.body: I remember we went back and forth on this question a few times, although I don't remember the details of why we ended up where we are today.

I do not think this is intentional behavior. In order to fix it we need to add `canRemain` check here: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/939a92bb4b1fe617b76d011988ac80c8af74ef0b/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/cluster/routing/allocation/allocator/DesiredBalanceComputer.java#L333-L335

I guess we just never had a time for this. Will add an item to the https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/91386
